description: This file defines the SizeNode class, which extends PcbNode and represents a size specification with width and height properties for PCB components. It includes a constructor for initializing these dimensions from a list of child elements and a toString method for textual representation.

classes.name: SizeNode
classes.description: Represents a size node with width (w) and height (h) properties, extending PcbNode. Parses size information from a list of child elements during instantiation.

methods.name: SizeNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes width and height from a list of child objects, expecting either one or two elements. Throws an exception if the size of children is not 1 or 2.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object's toString method to provide a textual representation of the SizeNode instance, displaying width and height.
